sentences.en: He seems to be oppressed by his monotonous daily life.
sentences.zh: 他似乎被单调乏味的日常生活压得喘不过气。

sentences.en: Why do physicists converge? Because they're monotonous and narrow.
sentences.zh: 为什么物理学家会聚集在一起？因为他们本身就很单调且视野狭窄。

sentences.en: Everyday life can get a bit monotonous at times.
sentences.zh: 有时候，日常的生活会变得有些单调乏味。

senses.zh: 单调的，无抑扬顿挫的；无变化的；不管

mnemonic: 词根记忆：mono（单个）+ton（声音）+ ous（…的）→一个声音的→单调的
